en.headline: Police arrest five over rental scam targeting mainland students and talent
en.dek: A group operating for about two months allegedly used fake listings and forged tenancy agreements to take roughly HK$1.04 million from nine victims; three remain in custody.
body: Police have arrested five people in connection with a rental fraud syndicate that targeted mainland students coming to Hong Kong for study and professionals arriving under the Top Talent Pass Scheme.

The Tseung Kwan O District intelligence team said the group had operated for about two months and was linked to nine cases involving a total of about HK$1.04 million. Victims were contacted through mainland social platforms with advertisements for Hong Kong flats. Some were shown properties by people posing as agents, sometimes accompanied by a licensed agent, before being taken to a modest office in Kwai Chung to sign forged tenancy agreements and transfer deposits or rents ranging from three months to a year into personal bank accounts.

On 12 October officers arrested three men and two women aged 17 to 45, including the alleged ringleader, on suspicion of conspiracy to defraud. Three remain in custody while two have been released on bail. A search of the Kwai Chung office recovered forged documents, a photocopier and electronic equipment. The case is being handled by the district’s serious crime team.
Police reminded the public that conspiracy to defraud carries a maximum sentence of 14 years’ imprisonment.

zh.headline: 警方搗破專騙港漂生及高才通人士租屋集團 拘5人涉約104萬元
zh.dek: 集團運作約兩個月，透過內地社交平台假租盤及偽造租約，涉9宗案件騙款約104萬元；5人被捕，3人仍被扣查。
body: 警方拘捕5人，他們涉嫌參與一個針對來港升學的內地學生及透過高才通計劃來港就業人士的租屋詐騙集團。
將軍澳警區情報組表示，集團運作約兩個月，涉9宗同類案件，總額約104萬港元。受害人透過內地社交平台接觸聲稱的公寓管理公司，部分人由假扮經紀的人士帶同睇樓，有時更有持牌地產代理陪同，其後被帶往葵涌區一間簡陋辦公室簽署偽造租約，並將三個月至一年租金或按金轉賬至個人戶口。
警方於10月12日以涉嫌串謀詐騙拘捕3男2女（17至45歲），包括集團主腦。3人仍被扣查，另外2人已獲准保釋。警方搜查葵涌辦公室，檢獲偽造租約文件、影印機及電子器材。案件交由將軍澳警區重案組跟進。
警方重申串謀詐騙屬嚴重罪行，一經定罪最高可被判監禁14年。
